description: This file implements the RuntimeManager class for managing containerized applications, including lifecycle operations (start, stop, suspend, resume, terminate, kill), event dispatching, and plugin object management within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerImplementation
classes.description: Main class managing container runtime lifecycle, event dispatching, and plugin object handling within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Represents a job for asynchronous event handling, created via Job::Create.

classes.name: WindowManagerConnector
classes.description: Handles interactions with the window management system.

classes.name: UserIdManager
classes.description: Manages user IDs associated with container instances.

classes.name: DobbyEventListener
classes.description: Listens to OCI container events from Dobby.

methods.name: RuntimeManagerImplementation::createOCIContainerPluginObject
methods.description: Creates and initializes the OCI container plugin object with retries.

methods.name: RuntimeManagerImplementation::releaseOCIContainerPluginObject
methods.description: Releases and cleans up the OCI container plugin object.

methods.name: RuntimeManagerImplementation::createStorageManagerPluginObject
methods.description: Creates the storage manager plugin object with retries.

methods.name: RuntimeManagerImplementation::releaseStorageManagerPluginObject
methods.description: Releases the storage manager plugin object.

methods.name: RuntimeManagerImplementation::getAppStorageInfo
methods.description: Retrieves storage info for a specific app ID.

methods.name: RuntimeManagerImplementation::generate
methods.description: Generates a Dobby spec from application configuration and runtime config.

methods.name: RuntimeManagerImplementation::getRuntimeState
methods.description: Returns the current runtime state of an app instance.

methods.name: RuntimeManagerImplementation::isOCIPluginObjectValid
methods.description: Checks if the OCI plugin object is valid, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: RuntimeManagerImplementation::getContainerId
methods.description: Constructs container ID from app instance ID.

methods.name: RuntimeManagerImplementation::Run
methods.description: Starts a containerized app with specified configuration.

methods.name: RuntimeManagerImplementation::onOCIContainerStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Handles OCI container state change event.
